One more thing. Up and Down are complementary. When a Buy Up crosses a Buy Down, the pool mints a fresh pair from their combined collateral. No seller required.

And when the evidence isn't strong enough, it refuses to trade.
That's what makes Firstbid a market maker built around evidence, not assumptions.
